Business Overview:[1]
AFGIL is in trading of glass and specialized glass products, procuring products frommanufacturers and selling it through sales managers or directly to its customers.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 58.0 to 31.4 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 13.9% over last 3 years.
